newsitem.title: USA: Candie's Inc moves toward global expansion.
newsitem.headline: Candie's Inc moves toward global expansion.

text.p: Candie's Inc said it entered into a long-term distribution and licensing pact with Bata Shoe Ltd, a wholesaler and retailer of footwear in Asia.
Candie's issued a news release saying the agreement covers the countries of Singapore and Malaysia with an option to expand into Hong Kong and Taiwan.
Candie's said the deal marked the beginning of its effort to "leverage the Candie's brand worldwide."

Under the agreement, Candie's said, in the spring of 1998, Bata Shoe Pte Ltd would distribute Candie's footwear through its 300 retail shops as well as the leased shoe departments it operates in department stores in Singapore and Malaysia.
